dimension.description: Which defect class this seat was hunting. Carried so a finding can be traced to the seat that made it.

claim.description: The defect in one sentence, stated as something that could be false.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, and the wrong output or silent pass that follows. Not a category.

sabotage.description: The exact cut that would prove it: what to delete or change, and which law should go red. 'None — nothing would go red' is itself the finding.

read.description: Files this seat actually OPENED. What was pushed to it and never read is not evidence.

not_checked.description: What this dimension could not check under its granted tools. An empty list is a claim that everything was checked.
